item.title: A thoughtful follow-up when it helps
item.summary: Murph can check back once on a private reminder or an important unanswered question, even if you've talked about something else since.
item.details: Before following up, Murph checks the conversation again and can stay quiet if the matter is resolved or the check is no longer useful. Follow-ups expire, won't create a chain, and can be stopped or postponed in conversation.
